title: SIAM: Open‑source Pipeline for Inertial‑Sensor Gait Analysis
description: SIAM is an open-source pipeline for gait analysis using inertial measurement units (IMUs). It provides modular tools for preprocessing, feature extraction, and machine-learning classification with a focus on reproducibility and transparency. This repository accompanies a submission to Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine (CMPB).
notes: This release contains the SIAM pipeline v1.0, including scripts, notebooks, and example datasets (synthetic).
